title: Headless Geckoman encounter (VES02DialogueGeckoman): the man's plea (50), the player agrees (60), the trap at the ridge (70) and his attack

actions.text: Path: the man by the road (VESGSGeckomanNPC) greets the player (GREETING 0x00158341: 50); the player hears him out (Topic000, 006) and agrees (Topic008, begin script: 60); walking into the ridge trigger (VES02GeckomanGSScript, OnTriggerEnter while 60) moves him there, adds his wait package and sets 70; leaving it adds his talk-to-player package, whose greeting (0x0015866A, at 70) has him start combat. Stages 10 and 100 are set by nothing in FalloutNV.esm; no stage completes the quest. Stand-ins: travel by move_player; the walks in and out of the trigger by trigger_enter; the geckos on the ridge are not fought; the talk-to-player package (AddScriptPackage, a stub headless) by talk; the fight by kill.
Stand-in for the climb to the ridge.
Stand-in for his talk-to-player package (VES02GeckomanTalkToPCPackage) walking up and greeting.
